title: IluBoard board.json
description: A kanban board in one file. Checks the shape of the file; `node iluboard.mjs validate` additionally checks that ids are unique, that every card's column is listed in `columns`, and that cards in todo/doing have done_when.

title.description: Board title shown in the app.

id_prefix.description: Prefix of generated card ids (B → B9, B10…). Optional: the most common prefix of existing ids is used otherwise.

updated.description: When the board was last saved.

columns.description: Column ids in display order. Standard: idea, todo, doing, done, dropped.

id.description: Stable id; documents link to cards by it. Never renamed.

column.description: Status: one of the board's columns.

order.description: Position inside the column, 0 = top. Renumbered 0, 1, 2… on save.

owner.description: Free text: max, producer, narrative, design, code…

done_when.description: When the card counts as done. Required in todo and doing.
